title: StitchLab What's New
intro: Feature highlights captured from scripted Playwright interactions.

items.title: List stitch mode: hole sequence or addition steps
items.note: Enable "list" stitch mode to treat numbers as either a sequence of hole numbers or of addition amounts

items.title: Onboarding autoplay tutorial
items.note: Autoplay of onboarding hints as tutorial

items.title: Paramless random thread startup preview
items.note: Random thread value selection on paramless load, including startup preview of the last three stitching steps with acknowledgments fanfare accompaniment

items.title: Hole number rotation remapping
items.note: Enable hole number rotation in Stitching for all stitch-by modes, as a new advanced frame slider control with label+target remapping.

items.title: Active thread configuration overlay
items.note: Active thread config values overlay shown during Stitching playback, with current thread non-styling control values and frame mode when nested frame is enabled.

items.title: Formula stitch mode improvements
items.note: Re-enable formula stitch mode with improvements
